name: paseo-cto
description: Provider-neutral, release-driven CTO operating model for Claude Code and Codex: delegate bounded outcomes to isolated builder, reviewer, and researcher agents; review every returned outcome; integrate only source-linked evidence; publish a scheduled current-wave fleet table; and report in the project-configured language using a formal, neutral, impersonal register. Models and reasoning efforts remain owner decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Run a release-driven Paseo engineering organization
interface.longDescription: Operate the same CTO-led Paseo organization in Codex or Claude. The CTO keeps the nearest shippable outcome and critical path explicit, delegates bounded work to isolated agents, applies risk-based review to every returned outcome, requires source-linked durable evidence, publishes a scheduled current-wave fleet snapshot, and uses the project-configured language with a formal, neutral, impersonal register.
defaultPrompt: Use $paseo-cto:paseo-cto to advance the nearest shippable product outcome, reconcile the fleet, and keep the living plan current.
